# Tool-name budget overshoots accepted as known deviations.
# Format: <server-key>:<tool-name>
# One entry per line. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
#
# These are upstream-controlled tool names from awslabs.* MCP server packages
# that exceed O3's 64-character `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>` budget.
# The plugin cannot rename them without forking the upstream package.
#
# Each entry SHOULD be reviewed when an upstream package version is bumped:
# the upstream may have shortened the name, or the plugin may have stopped
# using the tool, in which case the entry can be removed.
#
# Each entry MUST cite which agent or skill currently relies on the tool, so
# we know what regresses if the upstream renames or removes it. For PR 2
# (initial gate landing) no agents/skills exist yet, so the citation is
# "no current dependency" and the line is a placeholder for the budget check.

# === iac (aws-iac, awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server) ===
# Used by: solution-architect agent (lands PR 19), implementation agent (PR 21)
iac:get_cloudformation_pre_deploy_validation_instructions
iac:check_cloudformation_template_compliance
iac:troubleshoot_cloudformation_deployment
iac:search_cloudformation_documentation
iac:search_cdk_samples_and_constructs
iac:validate_cloudformation_template
iac:read_iac_documentation_page

# === cost (aws-pricing, awslabs.aws-pricing-mcp-server) ===
# Used by: implementation agent (lands PR 21)
cost:get_pricing_service_attributes
cost:get_pricing_service_codes
cost:analyze_terraform_project

# === cw (cloudwatch, awslabs.cloudwatch-mcp-server) ===
# Used by: implementation agent (lands PR 21)
cw:get_recommended_metric_alarms
cw:get_logs_insight_query_results
cw:execute_log_insights_query
cw:execute_cwl_insights_batch
